card.name: The digit 5 in neutrophil count thresholds
card.fires_on: The digit 5 (once a 6) that starts the hundreds in a neutrophil count cutoff such as 500 or 1,500 cells/mm3. It appears in neutropenia dosing tables, usually after ANC or 'less than'.

modes.label: ANC cutoff values
modes.description: The 5 of 500 or 1,500 in an ANC or neutrophil threshold for holding or stopping treatment.
